headline: Law lets veterans use VA education benefits at new branches of commercial truck-driving schools that meet certain conditions.
what_it_does: Normally, the VA cannot approve veterans' education benefits for non-degree courses at a school branch that has been open less than 2 years. This law makes an exception for commercial driver education programs at new branches. The new branch must be properly licensed and use the same curriculum as an already VA-approved program at another location of the same school. The school must send a report showing the curriculum is the same.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans and others using VA education benefits
who_it_affects.how: They can use their benefits for commercial driver training at newer school branches that meet the law's conditions.
Schools with an existing VA-approved program can get VA approval for new branches sooner by showing the new branch is licensed and uses the same curriculum.
The VA may approve these new-branch programs and must review the schools' curriculum reports.
